_comment: MOCK RUNTIME SCENARIO, not live output. Pins agent results in scripts/workflow_dryrun.mjs to the shape the synthetic fixture should produce, for mock-derived agent counts and the checker tests. Says nothing about live model behaviour.

claims.claim: Weekly quizzing caused the higher exam scores.
claims.evidence: 7.9-point difference between two non-randomized sections, d = 0.45

claims.claim: The effect will generalize to every STEM course.

return.argument: Classroom meta-analyses also find quizzing benefits.
The cited laboratory study does not test course exams.
Non-randomized sections with different instructors cannot license causal language.
One statistics course cannot support a claim about every STEM course.
